headline: Reps plan taking shape: more setups live is the only lever that scales, but more setups also means more lucky promotions - so it comes paired with a two-stage confirmation rule for the owner to decide.
bullets: Levers by new setup-days/week: adding setups ~+1 each (scales); Gen halt +7.5 and buying power +4.7 (small, unproven); spread/twin/short-gate/cost filters stay - skipped signals do worse.
Skeptic's simulation: with today's promote flag, ~11% of zero-edge setups get flagged within 20 sessions and only ~40% of +0.10R setups; at 100 mostly-noise setups, ~70% of flags would be luck.

Proposed fix (owner decision tonight): On Deck as a confirmation stage scored only on sessions after the move (zero-edge passes ~11% -> ~1%), and the number of setups evaluated shown on every promotion suggestion.
Calibrated replay (FWDCAL) runs tonight with per-day configs; rule-21 result follows.
Tonight's PR: owner memo, REGSW switching results, the promotion DECISION.
next: After 16:00: FAMC, REGSW runs, FWDCAL; then the evening PR with the reps memo and a DECISION.
